sections.title: AI companions and generated content
paragraphs: The Application offers conversations and roleplay scenarios with fictional, AI-generated adult companions, together with character creation and supported photo and voice features. Characters and their messages, images, voices, and stories are simulated; they are not real people, human-operated relationships, or representations of an actual person's consent or opinions. Any resemblance to a real person may be coincidental.

AI-generated content may be inaccurate, inappropriate, inconsistent, or incomplete. It is provided for entertainment and is not medical, mental-health, legal, financial, or other professional advice. Do not rely on it for emergencies or important decisions; consult appropriate qualified professionals or emergency services when needed.

AI functions require third-party processing and, where applicable, an internet connection, service availability, and feature access. Availability and successful generation of every response or media item are not guaranteed. Safety restrictions and technical limits may apply, including to generated content involving adult characters.

sections.title: User-Generated Content and Acceptable Use
paragraphs: User-Generated Content includes messages, prompts, character descriptions, images, audio, and other material that you submit through the Application. You are responsible for your submissions and for having the rights and permissions required to use them.

You must not submit content that is illegal, infringes third-party intellectual property rights, contains spam, phishing or malware, or is used for fraud, impersonation, or other misleading or deceptive activity.
You must not use the Application for abusive, threatening, harassing, defamatory, discriminatory, or hateful conduct, or to incite violence or illegal activity.

You must not submit or request sexual content involving minors or anyone depicted as a minor, sexual exploitation, non-consensual sexual content, or other unlawful or exploitative sexual material. You must not circumvent safety measures. The adult-only age requirement does not authorize prohibited content or guarantee access to unrestricted explicit material.

Do not submit another person's private information, likeness, image, or voice without an appropriate lawful basis and the permissions required by applicable law. Do not use generated content to misrepresent a real person or to violate another person's privacy or personal data rights.

The Service Provider reserves the right to filter, restrict, remove, or disable access to content or service use that violates these Terms or applicable law, to suspend access for repeated violations, and to cooperate with law enforcement where legally appropriate.

Lovira is not a public posting or social-network service. Content you submit in a chat is not published to other users by the Application. It may be processed by the Service Provider and the AI and other service providers needed to deliver the requested functions, as described in the Privacy Policy. If you export or share material outside the Application, you are responsible for the recipients you choose and their subsequent use of it.

If you believe content violates these Terms, infringes your rights, or is unlawful, report it to recruitment@marissagallagher.com. Include enough information for the Service Provider to identify the content, evaluate the complaint, and contact you if follow-up is required. Do not send unnecessary sensitive information.

The Service Provider may review reported content, request additional information where necessary, restrict access to content or services, and take appropriate action. Users affected by a moderation decision may contact recruitment@marissagallagher.com to request further review. The Service Provider will respond within a reasonable period and provide reasons for an upheld decision, subject to applicable law.

sections.title: Subscriptions and purchases
paragraphs: Some functions are available within free allowances, while others require a purchase or active subscription. General premium access covers the eligible chat, companion catalog, character creation and editing, voice, chat photo, faster-reply, and gallery functions shown in the Application. Roleplay Scenarios require the separate AI subscription offered on the Scenarios paywall. A general premium subscription alone does not unlock Scenarios; an active AI subscription also provides general premium access. Available products and feature access are described in the relevant offer.

Purchases are processed through Apple's App Store. The price, billing period, included features, and any trial terms are displayed before confirmation. Payment is charged to your Apple Account according to Apple's purchase process. We do not promise a particular price, trial, or trial eligibility outside the offer shown to you.

Auto-renewing subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple Account may be charged for renewal within 24 hours before that period ends, at the renewal price disclosed by Apple. A trial, if offered and accepted, converts to the paid subscription described in the offer unless cancelled in time. Any unused portion of a free trial may be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, as disclosed by Apple.

Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account subscription settings. Deleting chats, deleting local Application data, uninstalling the Application, or requesting personal-data deletion does not cancel a subscription. Cancellation generally takes effect at the end of the current paid or trial period, subject to the terms shown by Apple and mandatory law.

Use the Restore action in the Application to restore eligible purchases made with the same Apple Account. Restoration depends on purchase eligibility and verification; it does not create a new entitlement. Refund requests are handled through Apple's refund process, without limiting any mandatory consumer rights. A purchase does not guarantee uninterrupted third-party AI or media generation availability.
